channel.title: Notes of an old refiner
channel.description: Zapiski starogo neftyanika. Nurzhan, the dacha, and life on a pension

item.title: Dacha closed for winter
item.description: Closed the dacha yesterday. Drained the water, the pipes wrapped, the last apples in the boxes, the jars on the balcony (twenty-eight this year; the doctor says less salt, so less jars). The heating came on 15 October, and already the smog is back over the Chu plain, the radio says unhealthy…

item.title: Dima can read again
item.description: Dima writes from Surgut: "Ded, your blog opens again! I read three years in one night." So the technical works are finished. Hello, Dima. Hello, Valentina. Hello also to any new readers: the blog of an old man from Nurzhan, 86 years, still working, like the old refinery. Tomatoes this year very…

item.title: Prices
item.description: For the history (somebody will read this in 50 years): pension 1,410 som. Electricity from January is 0.32 som per kilowatt, Iradenergo now. A loaf of bread 3 som, buckwheat 1 kg 14 som, my heart pills 65 som, these are in dollars really. The marshrutka 2 som. I don't complain. In 1992 there was…

item.title: No connection
item.description: Some days in October the mobile internet in Talas was switched off, I read in the newspaper. In Nurzhan my home internet works. But now Dima writes from Surgut that my blog "does not open, there is a page about technical works". So my readers abroad (two: Dima and Valentina in Krasnoyarsk) cannot…

item.title: Pension day and the Kotelnaya
item.description: The 10th is pension day. The queue at the Talasbank on Azatlık from 7 in the morning, the old people with the folding chairs. Two hours. But then: Kotelnaya café in Dastgoh with the old shift, three of us now. Borsch, 100 grams, the stories we told 100 times. Kolya says, "Vitya, write about us in…

item.title: Quarantine
item.description: Since March they closed everything. No marshrutkas, the trolleybus only for doctors, checkpoints at the city exits. I am at the dacha with permission from the cooperative chairman (he wrote me a paper that I am "agricultural worker"). Only me and the cat. Dima calls every evening on the video. He…

item.title: The smog
item.description: Again this week you could not see the refinery chimneys from our balcony, and I can see them always, 3 km. It is the inversion: the cold air sits on the Chu plain like a lid, and everything from the heating plant, the cars and the stoves of the private houses stays under it. The radio says:…

item.title: Back at the dacha
item.description: I opened the dacha. Alone this year. The apple tree is alive. I planted Lyudmila's (her mother's) yellow tomatoes, the seeds she kept in the envelope. I decided: I will write again. Every Sunday if possible.

item.title: Lyudmila
item.description: On the 14th of February my wife Lyudmila Petrovna died. 49 years together. She was a teacher of chemistry at school no. 12 for 35 years, half of Dastgoh learned chemistry from her. Thank you to everyone who called. I don't know if I will write here more. Dima says write. I will try.

item.title: Tomatoes and a wedding
item.description: The 50th year since I came to the refinery. And our 47th year with Lyudmila. We celebrated at the dacha with shashlyk; the neighbours came, the old shift came (four of us are still alive from the cracking unit of 1975). Tomatoes are planted. The apple tree is old but gave flowers. Me also.
